advisory.situation: CRITICAL at 70s in Gate Throat. 57 people tracked; peak local density 2.74 persons/m2; mean speed 1.16 m/s; crowd pressure 3.824 s^-2. Fused risk 0.79 (high). Over the last 60s: density 4.1 to 2.7 persons/m2 (-33%); mean speed 1.21 to 1.16 m/s (-4%); occupancy 56 to 57 (+1).
advisory.mechanism: Crowd concentrated in a constriction while flux J = rho*v falls despite rising density -- the congested branch of the fundamental diagram.
advisory.root_cause: Bottleneck Congestion detected at confidence 0.55. Measured evidence: chokepoint at 100% of design capacity, holding 1.7x its share of the crowd; throughput on the congested branch (flux efficiency 0.39).
actions: CONTROL: open additional discharge capacity at Gate Throat; throughput is on the congested branch. Divert to Discharge.
MARSHALS: hold upstream flow in controlled batches at Approach until the queue drains. Assemble at Gate Throat downstream side.
SUPERVISOR: check for a physical obstruction narrowing the chokepoint -- congestion often has a cause you can remove.
advisory.do_not: Do NOT close or narrow the gate the crowd is already pressing toward. Closing the discharge point of a loaded queue converts congestion into compression within seconds -- reduce the flow upstream instead and let the queue drain forward.
advisory.broadcast: Gate Throat is congested. Discharge is now open -- please follow marshal directions and keep moving steadily.
advisory.time_budget: On the current trend, CRITICAL is reached in about 0s. WARNING: the recommended action needs about 120s to take effect, which is 120s LONGER than the time available. Escalate one level immediately and act on the faster intervention.
